articles.title: Space Telescope Finds Clues of Giant Crashes Near Young Stars
articles.summary: NASA's Webb telescope studied dusty disks around young stars and found signs that big worlds may be crashing together.

articles.title: Giraffes Can Count Carrots, Scientists Say
articles.summary: Scientists found that giraffes at a zoo in Spain can keep track of small numbers of carrots.

articles.title: Did a Science Machine Spot Dark Matter? Scientists Aren't Sure Yet
articles.summary: A detector called LZ may have spotted one sign of dark matter, but scientists need more data to be sure.
